summary: Iteration 49 — full backend + frontend testing of (1) P0 fix /api/ai-evaluation/health ImportError, (2) /api/ai-evaluation/config dynamic, (3) leader_election bg_tasks, (4) /api/reports/kpis day/week/month for TrendsTab, (5) Reports 'Tendencias' tab + toggles + 2 charts, (6) Layout.jsx split refactor, (7) JourneyDetail export PDF button, (8) ImageUploader compression label. Backend pytest: 9/9 PASS. Frontend Playwright: ALL verified green with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: worker_health() now correctly reads max_routes_concurrent from get_ai_eval_config(db) — P0 ImportError fully resolved, /api/ai-evaluation/health returns 200 with {status, worker{max_concurrent, slots_in_use, slots_free, cron_interval_minutes}, queue, last_terminal_job}.

/api/ai-evaluation/config returns envelope {config, defaults, bounds, model_map, pause_state} — config includes all 8 expected fields (model, timeout_per_guia, max_routes_concurrent, batch_size_per_route, max_retries, paused_until, schedule_enabled, schedule_windows).

leader_election working correctly — backend.err.log shows '[leader] acquired bg_tasks (worker=X)' + '[bg] Worker X is LEADER — starting AI eval + kosmo sync' on startup; lease loss/re-acquire cycles behave as expected.
/api/reports/kpis returns {data[], summary, has_data} for group_by=day/week/month. Each row keyed by 'group' (e.g. '2026-04-01' for day, ISO-week for week, 'YYYY-MM' for month).
Reports.jsx TABS render only when hasData===true (line 941) — expected UX, but means trends tab is invisible until a period with data is selected. Not a bug.
TrendsTab.jsx uses data-testid=`trends-groupby-${id}` for day/week/month toggles — all three clickable and re-render charts via /api/reports/kpis.
JourneyDetail export-journey-pdf-btn (line 800) clicks cleanly, no console errors, jsPDF+autoTable generates PDF client-side.

ImageUploader shows exact label 'JPG, JPEG, PNG • Optimización automática sobre 1MB' (line 113) on JourneyStartTab (Inicio) and JourneyCloseTab (Fin) — compressImages() integration verified by code inspection.
Layout.jsx refactor from 944L→447L shipped clean — /layout renders wizard steps 1/2/3 with CSV/XLSX uploader + historial de cargas panel, no regressions.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration49_health_config_kpis.py (NEW — 9 pytest covering health endpoint shape, config envelope, KPI rows for day/week/month, admin regression)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (0 console errors, all data-testids found, 10 recharts SVGs render on Tendencias, PDF export click clean, ImageUploader label correct on Inicio+Fin tabs, /monitor + /admin Motor IA regression clean)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing journey data (Ruta 9 abr 2026, MX-XScH4jJZYt) and 'Mes anterior' period (2026-03-01 → 2026-03-31) to expose Reports TABS (which require hasData).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: Reports tabs (including Tendencias) only render when hasData===true (Reports.jsx:941). In testing env, default 'Mes actual' may be empty — select 'Mes anterior' or 'Personalizado' with a range that has journeys (e.g., 2026-03-01→2026-03-31, has 33 journeys / 1399 packages). /api/reports/kpis uses 'group' as time-bucket key, not 'date'/'period'. /api/ai-evaluation/config returns envelope {config, defaults, bounds, model_map, pause_state} — the dynamic config lives under the 'config' key, not top-level. Auth: POST /api/auth/login returns {access_token, ...}, send as Bearer header. Tab IDs on /reports: providers/drivers/incidents/attempts/quality/sla/trends (internal IDs differ from Spanish labels). Preview URL: https://lastmile-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com
rca of the issue: N/A — all 4 iteration-49 features ship clean. Initial playwright run showed tab-trends absent only because default period had no data; switching to 'Mes anterior' exposed the full tab bar with all 7 tabs and 10 recharts SVGs.
